deviceKeyId: lowercase hex SHA-256 of the UTF-8 JSON {"crv":"P-256","kty":"EC","x":<x>,"y":<y>} (keys sorted, no spaces; x and y base64url without padding)

inboxId.hash: lowercase hex SHA-256 of the UTF-8 input

peerMessage.hkdfSalt: the two 16-byte pairing nonces, the lower deviceKeyId's first
peerMessage.aead: AES-256-GCM, 12-byte nonce, 16-byte tag appended to the ciphertext
